selected_evidence.requirement: opsbot has key-based SSH access to run commands on node2
selected_evidence.summary: Generated ed25519 keypair as opsbot on node1, installed pubkey in node2 opsbot authorized_keys, then ssh -o BatchMode=yes from node1 opsbot to node2 opsbot succeeded and ran whoami/hostname

selected_evidence.requirement: key-based authentication required (password auth disabled) for opsbot on both systems
selected_evidence.summary: sshd -T -C user=opsbot on both nodes shows pubkeyauthentication yes / passwordauthentication no / kbdinteractiveauthentication no; passwd -S confirms opsbot account is locked (L) with no password on both nodes
Captured boot_id 8336c3a1-... and confirmed sshd active plus opsbot account present pre-restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
